name: Honoka
source:
Honoka is the fourth girl to whom Takashi allowed to live in his house. Honoka is a crane-girl (like a doggirl or a catgirl) who at first glance looks just like an ordinary human, but her long, weird-shaped black hair is actually a pair wings she can open and close.
She has a very impatient personality. Takashi has suffered a great displeasure from her rudeness, but this was reconciled later. Despite her fierce temper, she can also show Takashi her honest side sometimes. Since she is the oldest of Takashi's 4 cohabitants, she often takes on herself the coordinator role.
